units.rawText: Inside Enigma, the Dandy-ified version of Neumann leads us along a corridor at a brisk pace.
units.displayText: Inside Enigma, the Dandy-ified version of Neumann leads us along a corridor at a brisk pace.

spans.text: Inside Enigma, the Dandy-ified version of Neumann leads us along a corridor at a brisk pace.

units.rawText: Just then... Your methods resolved the situation quickly. Looks like you're not entirely useless.
units.displayText: Just then... Your methods resolved the situation quickly. Looks like you're not entirely useless.

spans.text: Just then... Your methods resolved the situation quickly. Looks like you're not entirely useless.

units.rawText: So until now, you assumed me to have no notable traits whatsoever?
units.displayText: So until now, you assumed me to have no notable traits whatsoever?

spans.text: So until now, you assumed me to have no notable traits whatsoever?

units.rawText: Do you think your projection makes you look trustworthy?
units.displayText: Do you think your projection makes you look trustworthy?

spans.text: Do you think your projection makes you look trustworthy?

units.rawText: An attitude thoroughly different from before... Needing to re-establish a relationship of trust with Clukay without her memories is obviously an unexpected predicament.
units.displayText: An attitude thoroughly different from before... Needing to re-establish a relationship of trust with Clukay without her memories is obviously an unexpected predicament.

spans.text: An attitude thoroughly different from before... Needing to re-establish a relationship of trust with Clukay without her memories is obviously an unexpected predicament.

units.rawText: At least, Clukay is still Clukay. It's merely getting acquainted with each other again—for both of us.
units.displayText: At least, Clukay is still Clukay. It's merely getting acquainted with each other again—for both of us.

spans.text: At least, Clukay is still Clukay. It's merely getting acquainted with each other again—for both of us.

units.rawText: ...What are you smiling about? Weirdo.
units.displayText: ...What are you smiling about? Weirdo.

spans.text: ...What are you smiling about? Weirdo.

units.rawText: Data Center... we're here!
units.displayText: Data Center... we're here!

spans.text: Data Center... we're here!

units.rawText: Neumann shoved the door open in a hurried manner, bright light pouring outwards from inside.
units.displayText: Neumann shoved the door open in a hurried manner, bright light pouring outwards from inside.

spans.text: Neumann shoved the door open in a hurried manner, bright light pouring outwards from inside.

units.rawText: I squint my eyes, attempting to gaze inwards. Above the great outer shell of a computer, a girl's projection is curled up and suspended midair...
units.displayText: I squint my eyes, attempting to gaze inwards. Above the great outer shell of a computer, a girl's projection is curled up and suspended midair...

spans.text: I squint my eyes, attempting to gaze inwards. Above the great outer shell of a computer, a girl's projection is curled up and suspended midair...

units.rawText: She appears to be sleeping.
units.displayText: She appears to be sleeping.

spans.text: She appears to be sleeping.

units.rawText: ...What's all this?
units.displayText: ...What's all this?

spans.text: ...What's all this?

units.rawText: Sorry, sorry... Let me adjust the lights!
units.displayText: Sorry, sorry... Let me adjust the lights!

spans.text: Sorry, sorry... Let me adjust the lights!

units.rawText: —Alright, should be OK now.
units.displayText: —Alright, should be OK now.

spans.text: —Alright, should be OK now.

units.rawText: What was that light just then?
units.displayText: What was that light just then?

spans.text: What was that light just then?

units.rawText: There's no way you have to turn on all the lights to get her out of bed, right?
units.displayText: There's no way you have to turn on all the lights to get her out of bed, right?

spans.text: There's no way you have to turn on all the lights to get her out of bed, right?

units.rawText: That's exactly right! As expected of the ever-forthright Miss Clukay!
units.displayText: That's exactly right! As expected of the ever-forthright Miss Clukay!

spans.text: That's exactly right! As expected of the ever-forthright Miss Clukay!

units.rawText: Truth be told, I've tried all the methods I could think of without harming her. This is just another failed attempt.
units.displayText: Truth be told, I've tried all the methods I could think of without harming her. This is just another failed attempt.

spans.text: Truth be told, I've tried all the methods I could think of without harming her. This is just another failed attempt.

units.rawText: Not an uncommon method amongst human parents, I thought.
units.displayText: Not an uncommon method amongst human parents, I thought.

spans.text: Not an uncommon method amongst human parents, I thought.

units.rawText: So, any ideas, you two?
units.displayText: So, any ideas, you two?

spans.text: So, any ideas, you two?

units.rawText: Unfortunately, I can't say I am familiar with the steps necessary for awakening an AI. Let's seek out the omnipotent Miss Persicaria for help.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, I can't say I am familiar with the steps necessary for awakening an AI. Let's seek out the omnipotent Miss Persicaria for help.

spans.text: Unfortunately, I can't say I am familiar with the steps necessary for awakening an AI. Let's seek out the omnipotent Miss Persicaria for help.

units.rawText: Don't imitate Neumann, will you?
units.displayText: Don't imitate Neumann, will you?

spans.text: Don't imitate Neumann, will you?

units.rawText: Lemme see... Huh, when did ENIAC enter hibernation?
units.displayText: Lemme see... Huh, when did ENIAC enter hibernation?

spans.text: Lemme see... Huh, when did ENIAC enter hibernation?

units.rawText: This is going to be a headache. While she's hibernating there's nothing we can do. We'll have to send someone into her neural cloud to see what the issue is.
units.displayText: This is going to be a headache. While she's hibernating there's nothing we can do. We'll have to send someone into her neural cloud to see what the issue is.

spans.text: This is going to be a headache. While she's hibernating there's nothing we can do. We'll have to send someone into her neural cloud to see what the issue is.

units.rawText: I'll do it! Can I? ENIAC, Dad's here!
units.displayText: I'll do it! Can I? ENIAC, Dad's here!

spans.text: I'll do it! Can I? ENIAC, Dad's here!

units.rawText: You? Didn't you just say you guys squabbled? She'd be averse to whatever you want to do right now.
units.displayText: You? Didn't you just say you guys squabbled? She'd be averse to whatever you want to do right now.

spans.text: You? Didn't you just say you guys squabbled? She'd be averse to whatever you want to do right now.

units.rawText: Hearing that, Neumann's shoulders slump downwards in dejection.
units.displayText: Hearing that, Neumann's shoulders slump downwards in dejection.

spans.text: Hearing that, Neumann's shoulders slump downwards in dejection.

units.rawText: Before I could say any words of consolation, he whips his head around, looking towards Clukay with hope in his eyes.
units.displayText: Before I could say any words of consolation, he whips his head around, looking towards Clukay with hope in his eyes.

spans.text: Before I could say any words of consolation, he whips his head around, looking towards Clukay with hope in his eyes.

units.rawText: Then what of Miss Clukay? She's one and the same with Miss 416, and ENIAC should see the two as the same.
units.displayText: Then what of Miss Clukay? She's one and the same with Miss 416, and ENIAC should see the two as the same.

spans.text: Then what of Miss Clukay? She's one and the same with Miss 416, and ENIAC should see the two as the same.

units.rawText: ...You're certain?
units.displayText: ...You're certain?

spans.text: ...You're certain?

units.rawText: I can guarantee you, this lady is ENIAC's favorite. There's no way it doesn't go well!
units.displayText: I can guarantee you, this lady is ENIAC's favorite. There's no way it doesn't go well!

spans.text: I can guarantee you, this lady is ENIAC's favorite. There's no way it doesn't go well!

units.rawText: It may well work out, but we'll have to see what Clukay thinks of it.
units.displayText: It may well work out, but we'll have to see what Clukay thinks of it.

spans.text: It may well work out, but we'll have to see what Clukay thinks of it.

units.rawText: My mission is to protect the Professor. If the Sanctifiers were to make their way in while I'm being connected, who'll be there to stop them?
units.displayText: My mission is to protect the Professor. If the Sanctifiers were to make their way in while I'm being connected, who'll be there to stop them?

spans.text: My mission is to protect the Professor. If the Sanctifiers were to make their way in while I'm being connected, who'll be there to stop them?

units.rawText: Leave it to me, beautiful and mighty Miss Clukay, I will do my very best!
units.displayText: Leave it to me, beautiful and mighty Miss Clukay, I will do my very best!

spans.text: Leave it to me, beautiful and mighty Miss Clukay, I will do my very best!

units.rawText: You alone?
units.displayText: You alone?

spans.text: You alone?

units.rawText: Oh, of course! For a researcher to protect another, and for me to aid the Professor and Miss Clukay, I would not refuse if you asked a thousand, nay, a million times.
units.displayText: Oh, of course! For a researcher to protect another, and for me to aid the Professor and Miss Clukay, I would not refuse if you asked a thousand, nay, a million times.

spans.text: Oh, of course! For a researcher to protect another, and for me to aid the Professor and Miss Clukay, I would not refuse if you asked a thousand, nay, a million times.

units.rawText: Clukay looks at Neumann with suspicion in her eyes, but Neumann is oblivious. Helpless, she turns to me.
units.displayText: Clukay looks at Neumann with suspicion in her eyes, but Neumann is oblivious. Helpless, she turns to me.

spans.text: Clukay looks at Neumann with suspicion in her eyes, but Neumann is oblivious. Helpless, she turns to me.

units.rawText: ...And I'm supposed to trust someone like this?
units.displayText: ...And I'm supposed to trust someone like this?

spans.text: ...And I'm supposed to trust someone like this?

units.rawText: I'm no specialist at getting children out of bed either. She's on good terms with that 416, not me.
units.displayText: I'm no specialist at getting children out of bed either. She's on good terms with that 416, not me.

spans.text: I'm no specialist at getting children out of bed either. She's on good terms with that 416, not me.

units.rawText: ...Could you plug me in with Clukay? I may be able to help.
units.displayText: ...Could you plug me in with Clukay? I may be able to help.

spans.text: ...Could you plug me in with Clukay? I may be able to help.

units.rawText: If I am to stay in Clukay's field of vision at all times, she'd feel more confident too, right?
units.displayText: If I am to stay in Clukay's field of vision at all times, she'd feel more confident too, right?

spans.text: If I am to stay in Clukay's field of vision at all times, she'd feel more confident too, right?

units.rawText: From a technical perspective it should be fine... I think.
units.displayText: From a technical perspective it should be fine... I think.

spans.text: From a technical perspective it should be fine... I think.

units.rawText: ...I understand. I'll abide by your judgment.
units.displayText: ...I understand. I'll abide by your judgment.

spans.text: ...I understand. I'll abide by your judgment.

units.rawText: Words cannot express my gratitude, Miss Clukay and Professor!
units.displayText: Words cannot express my gratitude, Miss Clukay and Professor!

spans.text: Words cannot express my gratitude, Miss Clukay and Professor!

units.rawText: If anything is to happen, I will do what I can to immediately alert you two. I await your successful return!
units.displayText: If anything is to happen, I will do what I can to immediately alert you two. I await your successful return!

spans.text: If anything is to happen, I will do what I can to immediately alert you two. I await your successful return!

units.rawText: The process of connecting with ENIAC's neural cloud is unexpectedly smooth, and we met no obstacles. We are soon submerged within her Tertiary Layer.
units.displayText: The process of connecting with ENIAC's neural cloud is unexpectedly smooth, and we met no obstacles. We are soon submerged within her Tertiary Layer.

spans.text: The process of connecting with ENIAC's neural cloud is unexpectedly smooth, and we met no obstacles. We are soon submerged within her Tertiary Layer.

units.rawText: ENIAC! Stop playing around, you still need to learn how to utilize operands properly like we planned.
units.displayText: ENIAC! Stop playing around, you still need to learn how to utilize operands properly like we planned.

spans.text: ENIAC! Stop playing around, you still need to learn how to utilize operands properly like we planned.

units.rawText: As if! Haven't I learnt everything you've told me to learn already? Go do your own stuff, leave me alone!
units.displayText: As if! Haven't I learnt everything you've told me to learn already? Go do your own stuff, leave me alone!

spans.text: As if! Haven't I learnt everything you've told me to learn already? Go do your own stuff, leave me alone!

units.rawText: This is... ENIAC's memory data?
units.displayText: This is... ENIAC's memory data?

spans.text: This is... ENIAC's memory data?

units.rawText: Reading and learning... they aren't the same! Educating you is my responsibility, ENIAC. Listen, try a bit harder.
units.displayText: Reading and learning... they aren't the same! Educating you is my responsibility, ENIAC. Listen, try a bit harder.

spans.text: Reading and learning... they aren't the same! Educating you is my responsibility, ENIAC. Listen, try a bit harder.

units.rawText: I've searched through all of the data, and I'm done with it! It's all the same thing!
units.displayText: I've searched through all of the data, and I'm done with it! It's all the same thing!

spans.text: I've searched through all of the data, and I'm done with it! It's all the same thing!

units.rawText: But you have to... you have to learn, so that compared to the normal agents...
units.displayText: But you have to... you have to learn, so that compared to the normal agents...

spans.text: But you have to... you have to learn, so that compared to the normal agents...

units.rawText: This again! Telling me time and again that I haven't learnt something, and if I ask you what exactly it is, you don't even know!
units.displayText: This again! Telling me time and again that I haven't learnt something, and if I ask you what exactly it is, you don't even know!

spans.text: This again! Telling me time and again that I haven't learnt something, and if I ask you what exactly it is, you don't even know!

units.rawText: What right do you have to push me around like this, you frivolous administrator who does nothing but go around and chat up agents? You're nasty!
units.displayText: What right do you have to push me around like this, you frivolous administrator who does nothing but go around and chat up agents? You're nasty!

spans.text: What right do you have to push me around like this, you frivolous administrator who does nothing but go around and chat up agents? You're nasty!

units.rawText: The rebellious girl turned around, huffing, shutting down the operation of a series of databases in spite.
units.displayText: The rebellious girl turned around, huffing, shutting down the operation of a series of databases in spite.

spans.text: The rebellious girl turned around, huffing, shutting down the operation of a series of databases in spite.

units.rawText: Neumann stood to the side, hands tied. It was as he said, he couldn't really speak to the point. Save for his common mannerisms, it could even be said that he was poor with words—especially with respect to his own "daughter".

units.rawText: Wake up, ENIAC. If you keep shirking like this, the Sanctifiers are going to...
units.displayText: Wake up, ENIAC. If you keep shirking like this, the Sanctifiers are going to...

spans.text: Wake up, ENIAC. If you keep shirking like this, the Sanctifiers are going to...

units.rawText: Going to sanctify you.
units.displayText: Going to sanctify you.

spans.text: Going to sanctify you.

units.rawText: Uwah!
units.displayText: Uwah!

spans.text: Uwah!

units.rawText: That woke you up? Looks like you are not so dedicated to your little strike after all.
units.displayText: That woke you up? Looks like you are not so dedicated to your little strike after all.

spans.text: That woke you up? Looks like you are not so dedicated to your little strike after all.

units.rawText: Though, since you've been determined as an Irregular Agent for refusing to work, you'll be able to understand why I'm a fan of getting off work early, right? If you be good and cooperate with the reset, it'll be a win-win...
units.displayText: Though, since you've been determined as an Irregular Agent for refusing to work, you'll be able to understand why I'm a fan of getting off work early, right? If you be good and cooperate with the reset, it'll be a win-win...

units.displayText: Lady Angelus! Ple-please stay for a while!

units.rawText: Stay? Hehe, I appreciate the thought, but I'm only here to get the job done before returning to my holiday.
